ideas.title: The impact of the Minnesota social welfare scandal on federal funding
ideas.description: This story would investigate the potential consequences of the Trump administration's threat to halt federal funding for Minnesota.
ideas.angle: The story would explore the implications of the funding freeze on Minnesota's social welfare programs.
questions: What are the potential consequences of the funding freeze?
How will the scandal affect Minnesota's social welfare programs?
ideas.insight: The story would require analysis of the potential impact of the funding freeze on Minnesota's social welfare programs and the state's residents.
